roles.title: CIB Fraud Prevention Data Analytics Associate
bullets: Developed an algorithm that separates business from personal entities in live transactions by joining internal payment datasets. It scored a 97% success rate and sharpens machine learning rule design and fraud detection across multiple lines of business.

Led the design of an automated data quality system that validates 40+ field requirements to U.S. Government standards at city-level transaction volumes. It delivered 7 months of continuous risk prevention and protects the firm from high-value financial penalties.
Built and automated 50+ fraud analytics Alteryx reports with scheduled daily distribution to senior leadership and Tableau dashboard refreshes, removing about 11,000 minutes of manual work per week.

Spearheaded the end-to-end migration of legacy SQL queries and Tableau dashboards during the enterprise data lake transition, coordinating stakeholders and validation to keep reporting continuous and faster.

Led high-impact FinCEN and regulatory-support analytics, managing 170+ ad-hoc inquiries with 95% completed within 48 hours and a 0% defect rate. Co-led government-format reporting for 4,000+ transactions and developed procedures, quality checks, and reusable reference assets that improve consistency, auditability, and data integrity.

Delivered 250+ Alteryx Server deployments across new workflows, enhancements, servicing, and production updates, and scaled the team's automation environment to support 100+ daily automated runs, improving fraud analytics throughput, reliability, and stakeholder visibility.

Led the response to a data lake schema change affecting 60+ workflows, queries, and reporting processes: sustained manual stakeholder reporting during the outage, restored production workflows, and implemented a dynamic schema/query standard to reduce future operational, audit, and regulatory risk.

Delivered 16 marquee ad-hoc fraud analyses and supported 100% on-time GB/CIB MBR reporting across Tampa, Mumbai, and Bengaluru, including attendance and productivity reporting, translating complex data into actionable insights for Fraud, Recovery, Operations, and leadership stakeholders.

Strengthened fraud reporting, controls, and stakeholder enablement through laHUB recertification, firmwide Alteryx SAML/SSO support with a 100% success rate, AWM Unity Status reporting, RBAAD triage, and Fraud BOD Phase 2 analytics support, partnering across strategy, operations, compliance, technology, and data teams.

roles.title: CIB Fraud Prevention Product & Operations Corporate Analyst
bullets: Wrote 30+ SQL queries in AWS Athena (joins, JSON extract, table creation) for payment business cases, including fixing records, validating tables for new products, and supplying data to onboard a new fraud project engine.
Analyzed data across 25+ Alteryx workflows and applications to build new reporting, speed up existing workflows, and flag nearly 1K missing data lake entries.

Partnered with product leads on an Alteryx reporting solution spanning three payment types and databases with millions of client transactions, used by Product, Strategy, Operations, and Commercial Bank Fraud teams.
Worked with Cybersecurity Technology Control leads on updated procedures for senior management, and presented them in a virtual webinar to 200+ JPMC employees.
Helped prepare and lead technical and operational readiness for ten successful platform releases that improved fraud detection capabilities.
